chapters.label: Greeting & Introduction
chapters.summary: Agent greets the customer, introduces herself, and asks how she can help.

chapters.label: Identity Verification
chapters.summary: Agent requests the customer's name and confirms she is a patient.

chapters.label: Problem Statement
chapters.summary: Customer explains her need for a follow-up appointment and prescription refill.

chapters.label: Investigation & Discussion
chapters.summary: Agent checks doctor availability and discusses alternative options with the customer.

chapters.label: Options & Explanation
chapters.summary: Agent confirms appointment time, explains prescription refill limitations, and offers a temporary solution.

chapters.label: Resolution & Next Steps
chapters.summary: Agent secures a prescription refill, confirms pharmacy details, and advises on insurance updates.

chapters.label: Closing
chapters.summary: Agent summarizes requirements for the appointment and confirms no further assistance is needed.
